races.display_title: Irish EBF Auction Series Race
races.verdict: FIGHTING TEARS overcame inexperience to make a winning start at the Curragh last month, a performance deserving of extra credit given she fared easily best of those that raced towards the stand side, so she's taken to maintain her unbeaten record. The Scallionator is an obvious threat down markedly in grade, as is Zoar , who looked potentially useful when scoring on his second start at Naas recently. FIGHTING TEARS (IRE) THE SCALLIONATOR (IRE) ZOAR (USA)
races.betting_forecast: The Scallionator (11/8), Zoar (15/8), Fighting Tears (3/1), Belle Parvenue (20/1), Eyeconic (25/1), Nation Blaze (50/1)

races.display_title: Coolmore Stud Gleneagles Irish EBF (C & G) Maiden
races.verdict: MARCO POLO was caught out by the quick step up in grade at York last time but he had shaped with plenty of promise on debut and looks to have been found an ideal opportunity to get off the mark. Timucua Gold is bred more for speed than stamina and should be suited by the 6f trip, while Revelator took a step forward when third at Navan. MARCO POLO (IRE) TIMUCUA GOLD (USA) REVELATOR (IRE)

races.display_title: Follow Us On Instagram Handicap
races.verdict: GERRIT'S GEM shaped as if back in better form last time and is taken to repeat last season’s win in this race from just a 2 lb higher mark. All The Girls ran a cracker at Dundalk last time and rates the main danger if proving as effective back on turf, while Grande Cuvee is open to improvement now handicapping and Soulful Diva remains capable from her current mark. GERRIT'S GEM (IRE) ALL THE GIRLS (IRE) GRANDE CUVEE (IRE)

races.verdict: PINK LARKSPUR is a well-bred £150,000 purchase from a family that includes smart sprinter Wizz Kid and is taken to make a winning debut for top yard. Dreamology , a $600,000 buy and half-sister to useful US Grade 3 winner Royal Approval, is another fascinating newcomer and represents a significant threat, while Lex Victoria won her debut and sets a reasonable standard for them to try and surpass. PINK LARKSPUR (IRE) DREAMOLOGY (USA) LEX VICTORIA (IRE)

Blue Hercules remains winless but has the form to play a leading part and is next on the list ahead of Harper Violet and Act of Generosity in this intriguing maiden. LORD BYRON (IRE) BLUE HERCULES (IRE) HARPER VIOLET (IRE)

races.display_title: Deanta Fire Door Handicap
races.verdict: A tightknit sprint but ROYAL DUKE got back to winning ways over C&D last time and is weighted to go well again here so edges the vote from Bibendum who didn't enjoy the smoothest of runs when fifth that day. Both Cotai Starlight and Go Victor also need considering. ROYAL DUKE BIBENDUM COTAI STARLIGHT (IRE)

races.verdict: DONALD is yet to register a victory but signalled he is ready to strike when a very good recent runner-up at Newcastle so gets the vote. races.display_title: Watch Race Replays On Racing TV Handicap
races.verdict: A huge-field handicap in which cases can be made for several. PISANELLO continued his good spell despite having his winning run ended when runner-up at Leicester last month and David O'Meara's 9-y-o can add a fourth success of the season to his tally from an unchanged mark. Here Comes Louie is a 3-y-o knocking at the door, so he heads up the dangers, with Falcon Nine , The New Bay Pearl and Yafaarr just a handful of others to consider, too. PISANELLO (IRE) HERE COMES LOUIE FALCON NINE
